arcade.desc: Win the mini-game to reveal mission markers and the direction arrow for this chapter. If you skip it, the story remains fully playable using distance guidance.
arcade.rewardToast: ARCADE REWARD · CHAPTER {chapter} TARGET MARKERS UNLOCKED

REFLEKS.name: REFLEX
REFLEKS.brief: Hit the targets before time runs out.

YILAN.name: SNAKE
YILAN.brief: Collect data fragments without hitting the wall or yourself.

HAFIZA.name: MEMORY
HAFIZA.brief: Repeat the light sequence in the same order.

RAKET.name: PADDLE
RAKET.brief: Drag the paddle and beat the opponent without losing the ball.

KAÇIŞ.name: ESCAPE
KAÇIŞ.brief: Dodge falling blocks and survive the timer.

KATMAN KIR.name: LAYER BREAK
KATMAN KIR.brief: Clear the layers without dropping the ball.

METEOR.name: METEOR
METEOR.brief: Steer the ship and survive the meteor lane with auto-fire.

SATRANÇ.name: CHESS
SATRANÇ.brief: Find the correct move in short tactical positions.

TAVLA.name: BACKGAMMON
TAVLA.brief: Use the dice well and bear off your pieces within the turn limit.

TAŞ STRATEJİ.name: STONE STRATEGY
TAŞ STRATEJİ.brief: Beat the AI in TELKİN's main table strategy game.

LABİRENT.name: MAZE
LABİRENT.brief: Reach the exit in a generated maze.

2048.brief: Merge equal tiles and reach the chapter target tile.

KUTU İT.name: BOX PUSH
KUTU İT.brief: Push every box onto a target tile; boxes cannot be pulled.

KOD KIR.name: CODE BREAK
KOD KIR.brief: Crack the four-symbol secret code using position feedback.
